meta.what: Camping audit of every StarFinder place, read from each place's own official page on Nov 2 2026 (UTC times below).
meta.rule: yes = the place's own page offers any camping (campground, primitive, backcountry, dispersed); no = the page says no camping, or that the place is day use only; unclear = the page does not say. Only no is delisted (places.json listed:false); unclear stays listed.
